title: Annotated model
html:
Claim: “C gave the best value among my three tested designs.”

Numerical evidence: “A, B, and C gave 3.23, 3.50, and 3.85 clips per cost unit. Using the original fractions, C improved value by 19.1% over A.”

Reasoning: “B lifted 42 clips, two more than C, but its greater cost reduced its value. C gave more lifting performance per cost unit.”

Limits and next step: “This comparison identifies the best design I tested, not a universal optimum. Several settings differ, so I cannot attribute the improvement to one cause. I would next vary one setting from C, check both calculations, and continue searching.”

Notice how each sentence has a job. Use the structure with your own checked data; do not copy these invented values.

title: Q9 evidence notes
html:
Use your assigned Trials 1 and 3. Copy these prompts into your notes and complete them from the simulation:

  • Core material changed from ___ to ___.
  • Turns, core diameter, cells, and wiring stayed ___.
  • Current: Trial 1 ___ A; Trial 3 ___ A.
  • Clips lifted: Trial 1 ___; Trial 3 ___.
  • My explanation: ___.

Physics to connect: An iron core becomes magnetized and contributes to the coil’s magnetic field. Changing core material does not change the steady current when the voltage and wire resistance are unchanged. Explain both the current result and the lifting result.

title: Q10 notes & submission
html:
Copy these prompts for each of three distinct checked designs:

  • Settings: turns ___; core ___; core diameter ___ mm; cells ___; arrangement ___.
  • Results: current ___ A; wire ___ cm; clips ___; displayed cost ___; clips/cost ___.
  • Change tested and reason: ___.

Compare: My best design is ___ because ___. The three ratios are ___, ___, and ___. Actual Trial 1 baseline: ___ clips; cost ___. Improvement using unrounded ratios: ___% (one decimal).


Before submitting: Check both calculations; use at most 250 cm of wire and 50.00 cost units; reach a best ratio that rounds to 6.38. Keep testing if three designs do not reach the target.


Submit all 10 answers in Buzz. Q9 explains the core comparison; Q10 compares your designs. No separate report upload. Keep notes outside the simulation; its progress lasts only for the current browser session.
